text:
raj: Heads-up: eu-west1 apiserver started throwing connection resets about 14:02 UTC during a GPU pool scale. controller-manager restarted reconcile loops on a few nodes. seeing lots of `dial tcp` errors, seems like DNS/multipath resolving flipping backends. attaching logs.

oncall-bot: alert: APISERVER_CONN_RESET eu-west1 - 2065432100 - p95 latency spike :rotating_light:

alex: Can you paste the apiserver logs and `kubectl get endpoints` for the kube-apiserver svc?

raj: log snippet:
```
I0322 14:02:12.345678 1 httplib.go:85] dial tcp 10.200.5.12:443: connect: connection reset by peer
W0322 14:02:12.346001 1 pool.go:214] endpoint eu-west1-apiserver-3 removed from endpoints list
E0322 14:02:12.346400 1 server.go:482] failed handle request: read tcp 10.0.0.1:443->10.200.5.12:55000: read: connection reset by peer
```

raj: and endpoints output:
```
$ kubectl get endpoints kube-apiserver -n kube-system -o wide
NAME            ENDPOINTS                                 AGE
kube-apiserver  10.200.5.12:443,10.200.6.12:443,10.200.7.12:443  23d
```

sophie: hmm looks like the same IPs bounce between routes. any networking churn events in eu-west1? @tim

tim: We had a NAT gateway failover and a CDN edge config push around 14:01. BGP gossip shows flaps in AZ-b. pulling VPC flow logs now.

emily: Could this be the multipath resolver in front of the apiserver LB? we saw similar when backend healthchecks flapped due to TTL mismatch last month.

alex: Quick mitigation idea — temporarily mark the flaky apiserver endpoints as drained at the LB layer and shift traffic to the regional standby. expensive but stops churn. thoughts?

raj: I'll scale down the new GPU node attach batch to stop the attach/healthcheck storm and hold for 2m while we validate.

tim: VPC flows show repeated SYN followed by RST to 10.200.5.12 starting 14:01:58, matches NAT failover window. opening support case with provider and attaching pcap/BGP dump.

sophie: action: @tim file a support case w/ traces and BGP dumps. @raj keep nodes scaled down. ping when stable. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: incident update created: INC-20654321 - APISERVER_CONN_RESET eu-west1 (assigned: tim)

alex: thanks team. next steps: postmortem + check LB healthcheck TTL parity (service config vs infra). add remediation to runbook for NAT failover + apiserver multipath.
